answer_1.quote: Automatic question generation (QG) aims to generate questions based on a given context.

answer_2.quote: In accordance with previous studies on QG, we use BLEU4, METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), ROUGE-L as automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation in six languages ... and asked three native speakers to assess the question quality based on five criteria: Interrogative Sentence (I), Grammatical Correctness (G), Clarity (C), Answerability (A), Answer-Match (A.M.).
answer_4.guideline: assess the question quality based on five criteria: Interrogative Sentence (I), Grammatical Correctness (G), Clarity (C), Answerability (A), Answer-Match (A.M.)
